Name: Bone Node Stray Pixel Fix
Author: KaileyStardew
Description:
There is a bright white stray pixel on one of the bone nodes that spawns in the island dig site. Banish it to the shadow realm with this mod.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/MVR34cc/config-1.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Enable Mod:[/b] Switches the mod on and off, if you yearn for the return of the stray pixel.[/*]
[/list][img]https://i.ibb.co/JmHVzN3/compatibility.png[/img]
[list]
[*]This mod edits two pixels on the sprite for the bone node and nothing else. If another mod edits the bone node, it may look odd but would still function. But why are you installing this if you already have a mod editing the bone node?[/*]
[/list][img]https://i.ibb.co/MGL3tgc/requirements-1.png[/img]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/*]
[/list][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZW8hY5N/installation-1.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Install all the requirements above.[/*]
[*]Unzip Bone Node Fix into Stardew Valley/Mods. [/*]
[/list]The mod can be safely uninstalled at any point by removing it from the Mods folder.
